The '''Decent Bow''' is an {{Uncommon}} {{LI|Bow}} that is sold by [[Gregory]] during [[Ender Dragon]] fights for {{c|500}}. It deals {{red|+45}} {{stat|dmg}} and has no special abilities.

== Obtaining ==
A '''Decent Bow''' can be purchased from {{NPCSprite|Gregory}} for {{Coins|500}}. They appear in the {{Zone|Dragon's Nest}} during {{MobSprite|Ender Dragon}} fights and in {{Zone|Jerry's Workshop}} when a {{MobSprite|Reindrake}} spawns.
